findings.what_happened: The model misinterpreted summary_1 and summary_2 as reaching contradictory conclusions about Andrew Harriott's existence in the context, failing to recognize that summary_2 was an updated summary following the successful Hop 2 retrieval of Andrew Harriott. This caused the model to issue a redundant query in Hop 3 for an entity that had already been fully retrieved and verified.
findings.quote: The two summaries reach contradictory conclusions regarding the existence and team affiliation of "Andrew Harriott" in the provided (but not explicitly quoted) context.
